title: Monero AutoPilot — production manual QA
target: Windows x64 Tauri desktop; Monero mainnet; owned node over bundled Tor
rules: Exercise product flows with native computer control. A source review or automated fixture alone cannot mark a manual case passed.
Record the executable SHA-256, date, profile alias, actions, observed result and relevant transaction reference for each pass.
Keep private evidence and run results under ignored .runtime. Never commit wallet files, recovery words, PINs or financial identifiers.
Use isolated profiles for PIN changes, restore, process faults and installer tests. Preserve the funded wallet and its recovery information.
Real transfers are authorized between controlled wallets at 0.0001 XMR each, with fees no greater than 0.0001 XMR each. Record fees and outcomes; never repeat an uncertain transfer blindly.
After a fix, rebuild and retest affected cases. Production completion requires all applicable cases and release gates supported by current evidence; no skipped case counts as green.
Use controlled fault setup where necessary, but observe recovery and user actions in the actual desktop app. Describe the injected fault explicitly.
cases: Launch an isolated profile with no wallet or PIN.
Secure PIN setup appears; no existing user wallet is selected.
Launch, unlock and wait without repeated Connect clicks; repeat three cold starts.
Correct wallet opens, scanning completes, balance becomes current; no RPC restart loop.
Watch Overview through normal refreshes and several node observations.
Wallet ready remains stable; balance does not flash blank or zero.
Observe a real slow start or controlled delayed route past 90 seconds.
Friendly progress, elapsed time and reassurance remain truthful; no duplicate work.
Pause a ready wallet; inspect saved data and disabled operations; resume.
Wallet saves, pauses and reconnects to the same identity with current balance.
Temporarily make the controlled route unavailable; observe retries, restore route and click Try again.
No unapproved fallback; bounded retries, clear attention state and successful retry.
Stop only the identified empty-profile wallet RPC process; observe the desktop.
App reopens the same wallet, restores freshness and never creates or sends a payment.
Interrupt only the empty-profile bundled Tor process; observe reconnect.
Wallet stays private, recovers on its permitted route and never uses direct remote RPC.
Try to launch a second desktop instance against the isolated active profile.
Second instance gives actionable protection; first wallet and files remain intact.
Save & quit while unlocked; reopen and unlock.
Owned processes close; selected wallet, balances and history persist.
Shutdown succeeds and next launch remains locked.
Close with the title-bar X while connected, then reopen.
Wallet is saved and owned processes stop; no corrupt or abandoned active session.
After an isolated empty wallet becomes synchronized, suspend only its identified wallet RPC process; keep ordinary UI activity and observe the response watchdog and recovery.
After the bounded unresponsive interval and failed observations, the old process closes and the same wallet reopens; current balance returns and no payment is created or repeated.
Type letters, fewer than four digits, four digits, six digits and more than six.
Only digits accepted; 4–6 digits required and maximum enforced.
Clear refusal and cleared fields; protection is not configured incorrectly.
Create a disposable PIN; lock and unlock with it.
Only the correct PIN opens the wallet.
Attempt several wrong PINs, observe countdown, then use the correct PIN.
No wallet data revealed; retry delay enforced; valid access recovers.
Click header lock from a populated page.
Wallet and sensitive fields immediately disappear.
Use Settings Lock now, then unlock.
Same protection and clearing as the header action.
Unlock and leave input untouched for more than five minutes; inspect before and after.
App automatically locks after the configured interval without a test clock shortcut.
Save & quit while unlocked; reopen the same profile.
No balance or wallet detail appears before PIN authorization.
Submit wrong current PIN and mismatched new entries separately.
Both refused; fields cleared; previous PIN still valid.
Change PIN successfully; test old and new PINs, then restart.
Immediate lock; old PIN rejected; new PIN works before and after restart.
Populate unlock/change PIN fields; switch to a non-browser window and return.
PIN inputs clear on focus loss; no clear-text PIN is shown.
Open and close Forgot your PIN/About PIN recovery.
Explanation is readable and offers no bypass or destructive reset.
Try blank/whitespace names and a name exceeding the length limit.
Invalid name cannot create a wallet; limit is enforced.
Create a named wallet; observe pending feedback and try repeat submission.
One wallet created, clear operation text, no duplicate submission, correct selection.
Observe create/open/restore exceeding 30 seconds using a controlled delay if needed.
Operation-specific text and still-working guidance remain visible and accurate.
Create a second distinct wallet; switch between both.
Selected name, primary address, receiving address, balances and history follow the wallet.
Fill a Send draft, navigate away/back, then switch wallets.
Draft retained for same wallet; no recipient, preview, PIN or stale balance crosses wallet identity.
Try reveal without acknowledgment and with incorrect PIN; then correct PIN.
No phrase until both acknowledgment and valid PIN; errors clear PIN.
Reveal the empty test wallet backup and retain it privately for restore testing.
Exactly 25 ordered words, restore height and matching primary address; no secrets logged in source or shared evidence.
Reveal, switch to a non-browser app, then return.
Phrase hidden; another PIN-authorized reveal is required.
Reveal and wait 60 seconds without navigating.
Phrase is hidden automatically with clear feedback.
Enter wrong requested words and submit.
Backup not marked verified; challenge consumed and secret fields cleared.
Reveal again and correctly answer all requested word positions.
Backup words checked persists across navigation and restart.
Partly fill challenge, switch windows; repeat and wait its 120-second expiry.
Challenge and typed words disappear on blur and timeout.
Submit short/24-word and nonalphabetic recovery input.
Clear refusal; seed cleared; existing wallet catalog unchanged.
Use negative, fractional and future restore heights.
Invalid height rejected with actionable feedback; no wallet replacement.
Try malformed and valid-but-wrong expected primary addresses.
Malformed or mismatching identity refused; previous selection restored safely.
Restore the controlled wallet from its backup and recorded height/address.
Separate wallet entry selected; primary address matches; funds/history from chain are recovered.
Populate recovery words; switch windows or navigate away before submitting.
Recovery field clears; no secret retained in another page or logs.
Switch original/restored/independent wallets and restart with restored wallet selected.
Identity and selected catalog entry remain correct; original wallets preserved.
Open Receive for a ready wallet.
Complete correct mainnet address, address index and readable QR displayed.
Capture the visible QR and decode offline with an independent decoder; compare to displayed address.
Payload exactly monero:<displayed address>, with no truncation or wrong wallet.
Click Copy address, paste manually into a test field and compare.
Clipboard matches the complete displayed address exactly; feedback is accurate.
Copy current address, create another, inspect feedback, decode QR and copy/paste again.
Index/address/QR change together; copied feedback resets; new clipboard value matches.
Attempt a second click while a new address is being created.
One acknowledged creation, truthful progress and no unintended duplicate addresses.
Send 0.0001 XMR from the existing funded wallet to the controlled test wallet.
Recipient detects payment, reports exact amount and updates activity/balance after confirmation.
After creating a newer receiving address, send a small authorized payment to the previous one.
Same wallet receives the exact payment at its older address.
Observe received funds through confirmation and required unlock blocks.
Confirmed, locked and spendable amounts reconcile; locked funds cannot be spent early.
Pause connection, inspect Receive and copy the saved address.
Saved address stays usable; new address creation and sending are disabled until current.
Try malformed, wrong-network, checksum-invalid and whitespace-padded valid addresses.
Bad destinations refused; surrounding whitespace handled; full valid identity preserved.
Try zero, negative, exponent, comma decimal, more than 12 decimals and above 0.01 XMR.
Each invalid amount rejected without rounding or sending; valid atomic precision preserved.
Review a valid 0.0001 XMR payment from a known-empty wallet.
Clear insufficient-funds result; form recovers and nothing broadcasts.
Prepare an authorized 0.0001 XMR payment from funded wallet.
Full destination, exact amount, fee and total shown before any broadcast.
Selection retained, appropriate preference shown, fresh exact fee shown each time.
Exercise a controlled over-ceiling fee response in a native isolated test environment.
Fee and maximum explained; authorization impossible; no broadcast.
Use Edit payment, change details and prepare again.
Old preview invalidated; new recipient/amount/fee require fresh approval.
Allow a real preview to expire, then try authorization and edit it.
Expired payment cannot be sent; new preview can be prepared explicitly.
Try missing checkbox, missing PIN and wrong PIN on a valid preview.
No broadcast; correct error/backoff and cleared authorization fields.
Populate payment PIN and checkbox; navigate away, switch windows and lock in separate checks.
PIN/approval do not survive changes of view, focus or lock.
Confirm a reviewed 0.0001 XMR transfer to a controlled wallet within the fee cap.
One payment submitted; txid and pending state appear; total funds/fee reconcile.
Attempt repeat confirmation while the authorized transfer is submitting.
Exactly one transaction for that approval; no duplicate debit or automatic new payment.
Use controlled response interruption after submitting one authorized payment; reconnect/check status.
App reconciles original txid; never blindly sends again; unresolved state blocks new preparation.
Gracefully restart after a real payment is submitted but before confirmation.
Journal restores original payment; no duplicate; live status advances after unlock.
Send 0.0001 XMR to an address belonging to the same wallet.
Preview/history identify self-transfer; only fee is net loss; temporary fund lock explained.
After incoming funds unlock, send 0.0001 XMR from test wallet back to original controlled wallet when balance covers fee.
Both outgoing and receiving directions work; balances and fees reconcile.
Use Check status on pending and confirmed payments, including after restart.
Fresh confirmation count and status shown for original transaction; no resubmission.
Reject a preparation on a wallet with prior confirmed payments; wait through background status refreshes.
Error remains visible and in view until the next explicit action; no broadcast or duplicate payment.
Click and keyboard-select All, Received and Sent on empty wallet.
Correct empty states, no stale rows.
Review both sent and received real payments in each filter.
Correct direction, amount, date, confirmations and descending order.
Expand a transaction, copy ID and manually paste into a comparison field.
Complete txid matches the original payment reference; feedback targets correct row.
Inspect completed self-transfer under All and Sent.
Net cost shown as fee; no misleading double incoming/outgoing credit.
Restart and switch among independent and restored wallets.
Correct local history retained/scoped; restored chain history is not falsely presented as copied local metadata.
Visit all seven tabs, logo, Overview Receive/Send shortcuts and empty-wallet setup links.
Each opens correct page; no stale wallet data or unexpected external page.
Use Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter and Space through forms, selectors and disclosures.
Visible focus, logical order and no focusable hidden-page controls.
Resize to minimum and around layout breakpoints; maximize/restore; inspect every tab.
Navigation, QR, full addresses, inputs and bottom actions remain reachable without clipping.
Inspect lock, progress, ready, error, empty and payment screens.
Monero palette/Pip present; text and focus readable; errors actionable.
Use maximum name length and inspect full addresses/txids in normal and narrow layouts.
Content wraps or scrolls without hiding critical values/actions.
Build the final candidate, record hash and manually install into an isolated directory.
Installer contains only approved runtime/assets/licenses; installed binary matches tested candidate.
Launch installed app from its shortcut/independent working directory using isolated data.
Bundled Tor and Monero work; no dependency on source checkout or .tools.
Install upgrade over a controlled previous version, reopen test wallet.
PIN, selected wallet, backup status and history preserved; no replacement wallet.
Uninstall only the isolated test installation, reinstall and reopen its profile.
Application removed cleanly; wallet recovery/data remains intact.
Install and exercise setup, Tor connection and receive/send smoke on a clean supported Windows account/VM.
Prerequisites and WebView bootstrap work without developer tools; no unexplained security bypass needed.
Verify final EXE/installer signature, publisher, timestamp, version and checksums.
Valid production signing identity and metadata; final signed artifact is the tested one.
Inspect candidate contents and native lock/recovery paths with supplementary filesystem/network evidence.
No test wallets, PINs, phrases, credentials or private reports bundled; sensitive runtime files protected.
Review every matrix row against the final candidate and rerun cases invalidated by later changes.
All applicable cases have direct evidence; zero unresolved critical/major defects; no automated-only manual passes.
